name: Fall of Jerusalem in 587 BC (non-accession count of Nebuchadnezzar's years in 2 Kings)
description: Counts Nebuchadnezzar's years in 2 Kings without an accession year (year 1 = 605/604), so year 19 = Nisan 587 – Nisan 586 and the Temple burned in Ab 587; the "eighth year" of 2 Kgs 24:12 then matches the chronicle's Adar of year 7 (March 597). R. C. Young (2004), with Wiseman and Kitchen.
